subject: Re: CNN quantization kickoff — 4-bit training as a serving-cost lever
body:
Zofia,

Plan:

Staffing — Maren 50% (owns the codebase: bringing the tf_cnn_benchmarks-based stack up on current nightlies, it's picky about TF versions); Jorge 40% Feb–Apr (training infra + sweep automation); Farah 30% (eval + the accuracy/cost frontier analysis).

Compute — development fits on scraps: single-GPU runs (the resnet50_v2 batch-32 config) on Titan best-effort. For the June validation sweep: we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation — 384 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-15 — for the final quantized-training validation sweep, confirmed against the efficiency portfolio's quarterly allocation. cc'ing Ines so infra has the reference.

That week covers the full 8/4/2-bit matrix across the three model families with 3 seeds each. If we slip past it we're into OKR-lock season and I don't love our odds of a second slot.

Bao
